description: The closed table of which workflow a kind of task MUST run (primary policy section 8). bin/fm-workflow select <kind> --delivery <mode> reads it (--delivery is required for a kind whose workflow depends on it); bin/fm-workflow check validates it against the workflows. A kind that changes code and is not trivial resolves to a workflow under every delivery mode; the only ways a code-changing task runs no workflow are the exceptions below. A kind that changes no code and is documentation-only is outside the rule.

exceptions.trivial-chore: A trivial or mechanical change fully specified in the brief (a rename, a one-file edit, a format pass, a listed fact): the chore role, or the narrowest fitting role, one worker.
exceptions.question-or-diagnosis: A pure question, research or diagnosis that changes no code and records no decision: the researcher, scout, debugger or architecture role alone, reported to the captain.
exceptions.captain-none: The captain explicitly chose no workflow for this task: record the stated choice.

feature.meaning: new or changed behavior whose requirement is clear enough to implement without a written plan

feature-unclear.meaning: new or changed behavior whose requirement can be read two ways that behave differently, or is too large to start without an ordered task list

bugfix.meaning: a reported defect with a symptom to reproduce, to be fixed

refactor.meaning: restructuring that must not change behavior

ui.meaning: a change whose result is browser-visible or user-visible

decision.meaning: research that must end in a recorded decision (adopt, amend, reject); changes no code

trivial.meaning: trivial or mechanical work fully specified in the brief

question.meaning: a pure question, research or diagnosis that changes no code and records no decision

docs.outOfScope: the forcing rule covers code-changing tasks; a documentation-only change alters no behavior, so it runs no workflow (the technical-writer role, or the narrowest fitting role, one worker). A change to role, skill, workflow or policy Markdown that defines agent behavior is configuration, not documentation: use feature or refactor.
docs.meaning: documentation-only work: prose, examples and ADRs that alter no behavior and no agent-defining file

no-mistakes.why: no-mistakes owns review, fixes, tests, documentation, push, PR and CI: the independent QA, review and security steps of the other workflows would be a second manual reviewer on top of it (primary policy section 7), so the composed workflow implements and hands delivery to no-mistakes
